front.title: OAuth Actor Chain: Protocol and Interoperability

abstract.t: This document defines the protocol and interoperability requirements for OAuth Actor Chain. Six profiles combine Authorization Server declarations or actor-signed evidence with Full, Subset, or Actor- Only disclosure. Verified profiles create one actor proof and one AS acceptance at every actor step, with optional current-actor, disclosed-actor, or full-path evidence delivered inline or through introspection. This specification defines the wire formats, validation, replay and retry behavior, cross-domain preservation, resource limits, and IANA registration requests. A separate Informational overview provides additional design discussion. This revision continues the existing OAuth Actor Chain draft series, with Internet-Draft lineage beginning in SPICE in February 2026.
